name: Silhouette-based Bounding Box Initialization
definition: Initializes the scene's bounding box and adaptive learning rate using silhouette information from training cameras and ground truth.
summary: Silhouette-based Bounding Box Initialization computes a tight Axis-Aligned Bounding Box by projecting ground truth silhouette masks, distinguishing itself from min-max accumulation by resisting background noise and sparse sampling artifacts.
